description: Networked transmission of G-Code binaries to 3D printer and CNC endpoints (OctoPrint, Moonraker/Klipper).
author: Charon Librarian

transmit_to_printer.description: Transmits G-Code files over HTTP to networked 3D printer endpoints.

gcode_file.description: Path to the target G-Code file.

printer_url.description: Target printer endpoint URL (defaults to PRINTER_URL env var or local IP).

api_key.description: API authentication key for printer endpoint.

start_print.description: Automatically initiate printing job after transmission.

dry_run.description: Simulate network upload without transmitting payload.
